findings.title: Omitted training suppresses the required known-subtotal ceiling instead of publishing 55000 as conditioned
findings.mechanism: With a missing training category, coverage qualification correctly refuses an interval. Every real raw preview is conditioned and has pending coverage. planner-sensitivity's exactThreshold callback then returns unavailable before invoking the canonical solver because samples are not complete. Even if a mathematical value were obtained, sensitivity.ts forces threshold=null for incomplete coverage and finalizePlannerSensitivity retains a numeric value only when comparisonStatus is complete. W2 therefore exposes at most a sampled interval, never the explicit 55000 ceiling for the known components required by the immutable oracle.
